data.description:
## Description

**What**: Verify end-to-end API capability of the DIG Jira project before any reconciler work begins.
**Why**: The reconciler's identity model (label + entity property), JQL search, and conflict resolution all depend on confirmed Jira API access. Gaps discovered here block every downstream story.
**Scope**:
- IN: Capability probe — create throwaway test issue, write `dso-id:<uuid>` label, write `dso_local_id` entity property, run JQL label search, read property via REST, cleanup
- OUT: Actual reconciler implementation; production data mutations

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a capability probe runs against DIG Jira and round-trips: create test issue, attach `dso-id:<uuid>` label, write `dso_local_id` entity property, confirm label JQL returns the issue, confirm REST property read returns the value, delete test issue — exit 0 with no errors
  ← Validates Closure Check: "External heartbeat monitor configured and verified"

## Closure Checks
- Capability probe script committed and executable
- Probe run output logged as story comment with zero errors

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Entity property write requires separate REST call after issue create — sequence matters
- [Testing] All subsequent reconciler tests depend on these API contracts being confirmed

## Escalation Policy
**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a bridge operator, I can verify Claude has Jira DIG project access and capabilities
